
Abbreviated reference to [[The Complete Lojban Language|The Complete Lojban Language]] -- usual in the Lojban community because it is to date the only Lojban book!

Also known jocularly as the [[jbocre: Codex Woldemar|Codex Woldemar]], &amp; Lojbanically as ''la braxu'e ('Big Red Thing'), or ''le gencukta''.

''AKA the "Woldy Codex" and "The Woldy"''

''Also known, unjocularly, as "The Refgram" [[jbocre: = reference grammar]]''.
